items.title: Eddie Morris Interview, 1958-12-21
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Remember any of the guys with Cap'n? INTERVIEWEE: No, not him either.

ctx.x: In Joe Oliver's? No. I don't remember none of them used to work in Joe Oliver's band.
Remember any of the guys with Cap'n?

No, not him either. Because they left you right behind one another. Oh, I see. Yeah. But I mostly believe Frankie Duesen worked with all of them, him. Oh, yeah. Frankie Duesen, he just was the fellow you know. He used to get all them jobs and get who he wants. See, on the counter, that Pelican, well that was Frankie Duesen's place there, that Pelican place there. That was his place.
